annotation.title_en: Guide 1. Introduction to the AI Act

annotation.venue: Spanish AI regulatory sandbox pilot guides
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Non-binding introductory guide from Spain's digital ministry, produced under the national AI regulatory sandbox pilot, explaining the EU AI Act (updated for the Digital Omnibus): risk levels, operators, market surveillance authorities, sandboxes, and main obligations including high-risk requirements and conformity assessment.
key_provisions_or_claims: Non-binding practical guide to the EU AI Act; does not replace regulation
Explains risk tiers and operator roles (provider, deployer, etc.)
Deployers that are public bodies must carry out fundamental rights impact assessments
Maps Annex III high-risk areas to Spanish market surveillance authorities such as AESIA
Version 2.0 (July 2026) updated for Digital Omnibus amendments
